name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Your next days of events with the current one tagged: join the call, open it in Calendar, copy its details, delete it; a form adds one. EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux.
author: pal

settings.label: Source
settings.description: Where the events come from. Auto is Google once an account is listed below, else the system calendar (EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux).

settings.label: Google accounts
settings.description: One per line as `name = command`: the command prints an access token for the Calendar API (a bare token, or the JSON of an OAuth endpoint with access_token and expires_in). The command owns the secret; pal keeps the token in memory until it expires. In the config file an entry may be a table { name, token_command, calendars } to read calendars other than the primary.

settings.label: Calendars
settings.description: Calendar names (or ids) to show; empty shows every calendar. The filter dropdown narrows further.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.description: How many days from today My Schedule lists.

settings.label: Bar horizon
settings.description: The bar item shows the next event only when it starts within this many hours; nothing sooner, no item.

settings.label: Amber from
settings.description: The bar item turns amber this many minutes before the event.

settings.label: Red from
settings.description: The bar item turns red this many minutes before the event.

settings.label: Skip all-day events on the bar
settings.text: The bar item speaks for timed events only

store.tagline: Today at a glance, one key to join the call
features: Today: the day's events in order with the time and how long, each tagged `in 12 min`, `now, 25 min left` or `over`; tomorrow's once today is done; the next event's day when the day is clear
My Schedule: Today, Tomorrow, This week and Later as sections; the current event tagged `now`, the next one `in 12 min`

The bar item: the next event as `Standup in 12m` on the menu bar or sketchybar, `now` while it runs, hidden when nothing starts within 10 hours; muted far off, amber inside 15 minutes, red inside 5; a dot when there is a call. A click opens Today; Enter joins

Three sources: every account Calendar.app has (iCloud, Google, Exchange) through EventKit on macOS; `khal` on Linux; Google Calendar directly, per account, through a command that prints an access token (`gcloud auth application-default print-access-token`, a broker, a keychain lookup), so no secret ever sits in the config
`enter` joins the call when the event has a Zoom, Meet, Teams or Webex link (Google's conferenceData first, then the location and the description), else opens it in Calendar or Google Calendar
The calendar's colour on the row, the head count and a `Join` tag on the right; a filter per calendar
The detail pane: the description as text, when, where, the organizer, every attendee with their reply, whether it repeats
New event as a form (system calendar): title, a day in words (`fri`, `next mon`, `20 sep`), start and end, all-day, the calendar, a location, notes
Delete an event, or one occurrence of a repeating one, after a confirmation (system calendar)
Live with a 60 s ttl; the bar fetches every five minutes and on wake, renders from its cache on the minute

schedule.title: My Schedule

today.title: Today
today.description: The day's events in order with the time, how long, and where each stands (`in 12 min`, `now, 25 min left`, `over`); tomorrow's once today is done; what the bar item opens.

keys.title: Join the call, else open in Calendar
Details: the description, the attendees with their replies, the link

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: The next event as `Standup in 12m`, `now` while it runs; hidden when nothing starts within the horizon; amber then red as it nears, a dot when there is a call to join. A click opens the day: what is still to come with Join on the calls, the running event on a card, tomorrow folded.
